The conflict: applicant register "BAYKON Endustriel Kontrol Sistemleri San ve Tic A.S." vs document "BAYKON Endüstriyel Kontrol Sistemleri San ve Tic A.S."

Difference: "Endustriel" vs "Endüstriyel" — that's an accent difference (ü vs u) plus... let me check character by character.

Register: "Endustriel"
Document: "Endüstriyel"

Register: E-n-d-u-s-t-r-i-e-l
Document: E-n-d-ü-s-t-r-i-y-e-l

So register has "Endustriel" (10 chars), document has "Endüstriyel" (11 chars) — document has an extra "y". Hmm, "Endüstriyel" is the correct Turkish spelling (endüstriyel = industrial in Turkish). Register dropped the "y" AND the umlaut? Register: "Endustriel" — E-n-d-u-s-t-r-i-e-l. Document: "Endüstriyel" — E-n-d-ü-s-t-r-i-y-e-l.

So the register is missing the "y" and the diaeresis on "ü". This could be ASCII-folding / transliteration drift in the register (dropping non-ASCII characters and possibly a transcription slip). The rule says: "spelling drift, legal-suffix drift, accent differences = same-entity."

Is this spelling drift? Yes — it's clearly the same company, BAYKON Endüstriyel Kontrol Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., a well-known Turkish weighing scale manufacturer. The register form is an ASCII-folds/degraded variant. The document is the legal instrument and carries the accented correct form. The rule says accent differences = same-entity; best_value — the rules don't explicitly say which value for same-entity in applicant case, except number/year differences → register canonical. For same-entity generally, the document is the legal instrument, so the document's value is preferable when it's a better-quality rendering (proper accents). The "different-entity" rule says best_value = document's because certificate is legal instrument. For same-entity spelling drift, using the document's value seems right since it's the legal instrument and more accurate. Also extraction artifacts → register. Here document value is the accurate one.

Verdict: same-entity, best_value: document's "BAYKON Endüstriyel Kontrol Sistemleri San ve Tic A.S.", why: accent/spelling drift of the same Turkish company; document form is the properly accented legal rendering.
